items.name: Theme and adaptation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/style.e (D805): ThemeTokens with fourteen colour roles, seven text roles, spacing, radii, borders, elevation, motion and metrics; resolve for the seven control states over three variants; size_class and adapt for touch, dense desktop and compact; reference in Light, Dark and HighContrast; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_theme on both hosts

items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D806): Change[T] and Submit with fire_change/fire_submit as no-ops when unset; Region with a gesture mask and GestureAction; the runtime arena settling tap, drag start/move/end and hover enter/leave from raw pointer events with an 8 px slop; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_gesture on both hosts

items.name: Focus and shortcuts
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D806): Scope with traps_focus bounding Tab/Shift+Tab traversal in preorder with wrapping, up to eight Shortcut entries matched on key and modifiers, Enter as the default action and Escape as the cancel action resolved from the focused element upward; focused() for harnesses; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_gesture on both hosts

items.name: Editable text primitive

items.name: Viewport primitives
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D808): Scroll with wheel, content drag through the gesture arena (tap-only regions hand over past the slop), per-frame momentum, Clamp/Bounce overscroll with a spring back, a scrollbar thumb, Change[f32] reports, scroll_to/scroll_offset_of; the lazy form places virtual_count items of virtual_extent from virtual_first with visible_range naming the items to build and the reconciler recycling by key; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_scroll on both hosts

items.name: Semantic primitive
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e and lib/e/ui/accessibility.e (D809): Semantics node with role codes for the fifteen added roles, thirteen states, twelve actions, five relationships by key, live politeness, collection position and level, hidden subtrees left out; editors as text fields with value, selection, SetValue and SetSelection; perform routes offered actions to the semantics callback; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_semantics on both hosts

items.name: Host capability model

items.name: Surfaces

items.name: Scrolling and insets

items.name: Range selection

items.name: Text fields
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e and lib/e/ui/widget.e (D823): a shared field of an outlined surface, editor over placeholder and label; text_field, password_field over a secret editor (asterisk per byte, never copied), search_field with submit and a clear button, text_area rows tall; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_field on both hosts

items.name: Basic choice

items.name: Forms
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D825): field_label with the required asterisk controlling its field, field_message as a live status (assertive and invalid when so), form_field as a group labelled by its label, described by its help and errored by its message with required and invalid as states, form as a scope whose Enter and Escape are the caller's over a column or (expanded) a wrap, validation_summary as an assertive alert of links jumping to their fields; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_form on both hosts

items.name: Disclosure and panes
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D826): disclosure as a header button with a painted triangle, expanded and controlling its content group, expander the same on a surface; tabs as plain tab buttons under a tab list with Left and Right as scope shortcuts picking the neighbours, tab_view showing the selected page labelled by its tab; resizable_pane and split_view with a focusable drag handle (a slider in the tree) reporting the pane size clamped to its limits, nudged by the arrow keys; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_panes on both hosts

items.name: Basic transient UI

items.name: Basic application navigation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/navigation.e (D828): app_bar with leading and trailing action buttons around a level-1 heading on the primary colour, toolbar and status_bar as a named group and a polite status on the surface variant, navigation_stack placing the top page under an app bar whose back button and whose scope's Escape (the host back gesture) fire pop, destination_form choosing bottom, rail or sidebar by size class and destination_bar laying the destinations out as a row or a column of tabs; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_navigation on both hosts

items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D829): split_button as a filled primary joined to a chevron button that toggles, says expanded and controls the menu the caller anchors to it; speed_dial as a round button expanding into a modal overlay of its actions above itself; chip in four kinds (a filter chip is a checkbox, an input chip carries a remove button); rating as painted stars set by a tap and stepped by the arrow keys from one focusable row, a slider with digits in the tree; menu_button is lib/e/ui/overlay.e (D827) beside the menu it opens; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_actions and ui_transient on both hosts

items.name: Numeric and shortcut input
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D830): stepper as two bound-disabled buttons around the value with Up/Down as scope shortcuts, spin_box as a text field over the caller's buffer holding the value's digits with the same buttons and keys and typed text reported to the caller, dial as a custom-painted knob turned to where the pointer points (atan2 about its middle over three quarters of a turn) and by a hundredth on the arrow keys, shortcut_recorder naming a Chord and taking every key through the new Scope.keys while recording; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_numeric on both hosts

items.name: Advanced text and choice input
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D831): formatted_field invalid while its Format adapter refuses the text and writing the formatted text back on Enter, autocomplete and combo_box over one suggesting helper (a non-modal list below the field, Up/Down activating, Enter picking, Escape dismissing, the chevron toggling), token_field as input chips wrapped before a field whose Enter adds, picker as the popup select or a centred modal sheet of rows, multi_select_list as the list box's rows with a flag each; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_entry on both hosts

items.name: Feedback and disclosure
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D832): gauge as a progress ring with the value written under it, level as a bar coloured by its warn and danger shares and invalid past danger, snackbar and toast over one noticed helper showing the head of the caller's Notice queue as a non-modal overlay at the bottom or the top right with its action and close, banner and info_bar over one noted helper (an alert when warning or error, a status otherwise, the info bar with a close), skeleton breathing with the caller's phase unless motion is reduced, empty_state as icon, title, message and button, accordion as disclosures with one open; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_feedback on both hosts

items.name: Virtual collections
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D833): a bounded Source (count, stable key, build into the arena) and a caller-owned selection of keys; list as static rows with separators under a list, virtual_list building only the rows widget.visible_range names at the offset into a lazy viewport keyed by the source, grid_view wrapping cells of a size across the width (as many columns as fit), virtual_grid building only the visible rows of cells with each row keyed for the reconciler; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_collection on both hosts counts the builds

items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D835): page_view showing one page in a clipped drag region that turns once per swipe past a quarter of its width (the swipe's one flag kept in the view's widget state cell) and on Left/Right, page_indicator as tap dots under a tab list, pagination as Previous, a window of numbered pages and Next disabled at the ends, carousel composing the three over one turn; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_paged on both hosts

items.name: Collection interaction
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D839): reorderable_list as focusable drag rows whose drop reports a Reorder from the row's index to the row under the pointer and whose Alt+Up/Alt+Down report a move by one, pull_to_refresh firing once per pull past a third of the height with a Refresh button as the keyboard alternative and a busy ring while refreshing, swipe_actions revealing a row's action buttons once per swipe left and hiding on a swipe right with a More button for a keyboard; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_interaction on both hosts

items.evidence: lib/e/ui/navigation.e (D840): menu_bar as a row of overlay menu buttons sixteen keys apart with one open, context_menu as the overlay menu at an anchor, navigation_split as the split view at medium width and one page (the detail while showing_detail) when compact, navigation_drawer as a modal sidebar overlay along the left edge dismissed by Escape or a press outside, navigation_rail/bottom_navigation/sidebar as the destination bar's explicit forms, breadcrumbs as links with slashes and the current name as text; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_adaptive on both hosts

items.name: Transient presentation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/overlay.e (D841): popup as a non-modal raised surface against an anchor, flyout and popover as light-dismissed modal popups (Escape and a press outside fire dismiss, the popover with a heading and a close), dialog generalising alert_dialog over any content, sheet and bottom_sheet as modal panels along the right and bottom edges through one edged helper, action_sheet as a bottom sheet of full-width action buttons with Cancel last; widget.e's key walk now starts at the topmost modal overlay's scope when the focus is not inside it; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_presentation on both hosts

items.name: Pickers
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/overlay.e (D842): calendar as a header of month turns over weeks of day buttons (Monday first, e.time's civil-day arithmetic, the selected day filled, a range tinted), date_picker and date_range_picker as an outlined button reading the value with the calendar in a light-dismissed flyout, time_picker and duration_picker as steppers per part reporting the whole value, color_picker as a swatch beside one slider per channel; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_pickers on both hosts

items.name: Content manipulation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D844): the Zoom kind painting its children scaled and offset through a clipped transform, the wheel scaling about the pointer within the limits, a drag panning, the offset bounded to the view and every move reported (zoom_state_of for a harness); begin_drag/dragging carrying a payload from a drag region's start to the region under the release that takes GESTURE_DROP, which hears Gesture.Drop; clipboard_commands/copy/cut/paste on the focused editor and clipboard_set/get over the host clipboard with the runtime's fallback; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_manipulation on both hosts

items.name: Rich tabular data
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D845): table and data_grid over a TableSource (count, key, cell) in the lazy viewport under a header row whose taps report the column to sort, whose drags carry the column as a D844 drop payload for a Reorder, and whose handles report a ColumnResize, rows picking by key and marked from a key selection; tree and outline over a TreeSource (count/key per parent, has_children, build) flattening only the expanded nodes, marks and Left/Right toggling, rows picking, tree items with level and position; tree_table hanging CellSource columns off the tree under the same header; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_tabular on both hosts

items.name: Property editing
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D851): property_grid over a PropertySource (count, property with key/name/group, editor built by the caller) as name and editor rows under disclosure group headings the caller collapses by key, a table of two columns with row headers; key_value_editor as a row a Pair of two text fields over the caller's buffers and a remove, every keystroke reported as a PairEdit with the index and the side, removes by index, an Add button; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_property on both hosts

items.name: Document workspace
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/navigation.e (D852): document_tabs as tab regions that pick on a tap, close from a button unless pinned, mark dirty titles, move by a D844 drag onto another tab (a DocumentMove) and pick neighbours on Left/Right; dock_panel as a title bar with a close over content; dock_layout as nested resizable panes (left, middle sizing the right by what remains, centre over bottom) reporting the whole DockSizes; multi_document_workspace as the tabs over the view with Ctrl+W, Ctrl+PageDown and Ctrl+PageUp; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_workspace on both hosts

items.name: Productivity navigation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/navigation.e (D853): wizard as the step names (done marked, current in the tree) over the step's content and a footer of Cancel, Back and Next or Finish with the caller's can_advance disabling and the scope's Enter and Escape; window_switcher and command_palette as centred modal panels over one choice_rows/choice_scope pair (Up/Down activate, Enter and taps pick or run, Escape and a press outside dismiss), the palette with a search field the caller filters by; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_productivity on both hosts

items.name: Desktop selection and history
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D854): font_picker over the caller's catalogue as a list box of families, a segmented control of styles, a size stepper and a preview line, each choice reported by index or size; notification_list as the caller's Notice queue in a viewport, a row a notice with its action and its close, and a Clear all button; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_desktop on both hosts

items.name: System tray and status items
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/app.e (D886): Tray as a typed controller over e.os.shell -- tray_open/tray_set_icon/tray_set_tooltip/tray_close under one id, tray_set_badge composing a disc into the icon's pixels, tray_set_menu attaching the shell's own popup menu, tray_poll turning the shell's activations into Select, Open, Command (the chosen item) or Dismissed, and tray_supported plus shell.Unsupported everywhere on a host without a tray; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_tray on both hosts

items.name: Windows shell integration
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D887): taskbar_progress (state and completed of total on the app window's button), taskbar_overlay (an icon from the caller's pixels with a spoken description, cleared by an icon of no width) and jump_list/jump_list_clear (the application's tasks as shell links with a title in their property store, replaced whole and removed) over ITaskbarList3, ICustomDestinationList, IObjectCollection, IShellLinkW and IPropertyStore reached by vtable slot through extern fn pointer types; e.ui.window.host_window hands the app's window to them; Linux answers Unsupported with the capability record saying so; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_taskbar on both hosts

items.name: Native notifications
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e, lib/e/os/shell.linux.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D889): notify/notification_update/notification_remove over the shell's balloon on the app's tray item (Windows, activation and dismissal routed through tray_poll as NoticeSelect and NoticeDismiss) and the desktop daemon through notify-send (Linux, the daemon's id replaced in place, removal Unsupported); notification_permission is the host's answer (Granted, Denied, Unavailable) asked before the first notice; notification_actions_supported is the honest false on both hosts, since neither offers buttons this way; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_notification on both hosts

items.name: Typed host data exchange
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/app.e (D891): ContentType as a kind and MIME name with content_type_name/content_type_of mapping to and from the MIME names the host formats stand for; DataOffer as the types on offer over a DataProvider that produces each representation only when a hand-off materialises the offer (offer_materialize, in order, refusing a provider that answers the wrong type); DataRepresentation is shell.Content itself, one per representation; offer_of is the eager offer over items in hand; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_exchange_model on both hosts

items.name: Cross-application drag and drop
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/app.e and lib/e/os/shell.windows.e (D892): drag_offer materialises a DataOffer and hands it to the shell's DoDragDrop under the DragOperation the caller allows, answering Copied, Moved or Cancelled; drop_target_open/drop_target_close make the app's window an IDropTarget whose drops land in the caller's storage and are taken in order by drop_take; promised_file is the .Promise representation the shell carries as FileGroupDescriptorW/FileContents both ways; Linux answers Unsupported with the two predicates saying so first; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_drag_drop on both hosts

items.name: System clipboard and sharing
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/app.e (D893): clipboard_offer writes a materialised DataOffer as its representations, clipboard_holds asks without reading and clipboard_take gives one representation back by type; ClipboardMonitor remembers the shell's change counter and clipboard_changed compares it, so a change is learned without an unsolicited read; share/share_target_take are the honest Unsupported on both hosts (WinRT DataTransferManager and the desktop portal are not spoken), with share_supported and share_target_supported saying so first; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_clipboard on both hosts

items.name: File and document access
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D894/D895): open_file, save_file and pick_folder over the shell's IFileOpenDialog/IFileSaveDialog by slot (filters, initial name, default extension, multiple selection, an owner window or none, Cancelled on close), each answering a DocumentGrant that is the path on the desktop hosts and a type of its own for a sandboxed one; recent_add over SHAddToRecentDocs of an existing document; Linux Unsupported with file_dialogs_supported and recent_documents_supported saying so; driven by hand on Windows (open accepted, save cancelled, folder picked); tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_file_access on both hosts

items.name: Activation and associations
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e, lib/e/os/shell.linux.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D896/D897): activation reads the command line as a launch, a file or a URL on both hosts; register_file_type/register_protocol and their unregister_* write and remove the per-user registry association on Windows; startup_registration/startup_registered set and query the Run value on Windows and the freedesktop autostart entry on Linux; single_instance is a named mutex whose first holder receives later instances' arguments through activation_poll (a probe drove two secondaries into a primary); the predicates say what the host has and the rest is Unsupported; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_activation on both hosts

items.name: Shell file operations
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/app.e (D888): open_uri, reveal_in_file_manager and move_to_trash delegate to e.os.shell's open verb, reveal and trash and answer as the shell does (Invalid for an empty argument, NotFound for a missing item, Unsupported where the host has no verb), with shell_capabilities saying beforehand which verbs the host has; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_shell_ops on both hosts

items.name: Global input and lifecycle
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e, lib/e/os/shell.linux.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D898/D899): GlobalShortcutSession over RegisterHotKey on the hidden window with global_shortcut_poll draining WM_HOTKEY; background_permission as the host's answer; login_item_set/login_item_enabled as D897's startup registration under the name a login item has; PowerInhibitor over SetThreadExecutionState (Windows) and a systemd-inhibit child (Linux); lifecycle_poll over WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION and WM_POWERBROADCAST; session_restore_register over RegisterApplicationRestart with activation reading the arguments back; the predicates say what the host has and Linux answers Unsupported for shortcuts, events and restart; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_lifecycle on both hosts

items.name: Native printing
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D900/D901): print_dialog over PrintDlgW with PD_RETURNDC answering the chosen printer, range and copies; page_setup_dialog over PageSetupDlgW in hundredths of a millimetre; PrintJob over StartDocW/StartPage/StretchDIBits/EndPage/EndDoc with AbortDoc as the cancel, pages as pixels stretched over printer_page's printable area, and an output path for the printers that write a file; printer_open by name or default; Linux Unsupported with printing_supported and print_dialogs_supported saying so; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_print prints one page to the PDF printer's file and cancels a second job on Windows

items.name: Hardware and security services
items.evidence: lib/e/os/shell.windows.e, lib/e/os/shell.linux.e and lib/e/ui/app.e (D902/D903): permission_status/permission_request read the user's consent from the registry's ConsentStore and open the capability's settings page on a denial; camera_access, microphone_access and location_access are that gate for their capability; pick_photos is the open dialog over the Pictures folder with image filters; biometric_verify is the honest Unsupported with biometrics_supported false on both hosts; credential_store/credential_read/credential_delete over the Credential Manager (Windows) and secret-tool (Linux); screen_capture over GDI into pixels; the predicates say what the host has and Linux answers Unavailable and Unsupported for the rest; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_permissions on both hosts
